field_contract.evidence_date: Use an ISO 8601 calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format for evidence.date. Future-dated pilot movement evidence is invalid because it cannot be completed evidence.
field_contract.placeholder_values: Placeholder text such as PENDING is treated as missing evidence case-insensitively and after trimming. Lowercase, padded, or whitespace-only placeholders cannot satisfy required FR-017 pilot movement fields.
field_contract.pilot_identity_linkage: evidence.pilot_id must match evidence.pilot_id in the linked pilot static-fit record. Do not use movement evidence for one pilot with static-fit evidence collected from another pilot.
field_contract.record_linkage: pilot_static_fit_record_path must resolve to the same static-fit record path passed into the pilot movement gate. Do not point movement evidence at stale, copied, or unrelated static-fit records.
field_contract.evidence_chronology: Pilot movement evidence.date must be the same as or later than the linked pilot static-fit evidence.date. Do not fabricate or backdate movement evidence before static-fit evidence exists.
field_contract.test_duration: Use an unquoted JSON number greater than 0 for evidence.test_duration_minutes. Quoted numeric strings are invalid. PENDING is treated as missing evidence.
field_contract.required_pass_checks: Use unquoted JSON boolean true only when the movement condition is directly verified. Use false for a verified failure; false blocks progression.
field_contract.symptoms: Use false only when the symptom is absent. Use true when observed; true blocks progression. Do not use yes/no/1/0 or quoted true/false strings.
